info.title: LaGrowthMachine Universal API
info.description: Multichannel outbound sales automation platform for campaigns, leads, audiences, inbox workflows, and prospecting operations.

post.description: Creates an audience in LaGrowthMachine from a LinkedIn URL.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

audience.description: Audience name to populate from the LinkedIn search or post.

identityId.description: Identity ID used to impersonate the LinkedIn search query.

linkedinPostCategory.description: Post interaction category when importing from a LinkedIn post.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn regular search URL, Sales Navigator search URL, or LinkedIn post URL.

statusCode.description: Provider status code returned after the audience import request.
